GU_ZHEN_REN_RELIC_KONG_QIAO_RELIC.title: Aperture
GU_ZHEN_REN_RELIC_KONG_QIAO_RELIC.descri: After winning combat, gain cultivation and advance in rank when enough is accumulated. At ranks 2–5, the first Gu card each combat with a rank below your aperture can be played for free. From rank 6 onward, add the corresponding Immortal Essence to your hand at the start of combat. Currently capped at rank 9.
GU_ZHEN_REN_RELIC_KONG_QIAO_RELIC.flavor: A world exists within the aperture; with a thought, all beings may be refined.
